A styled Base UI tooltip around any trigger element. Never use a native title attribute alongside it.

props.name: content
props.description: Tooltip text or content.

props.description: The trigger element; its props, ref and handlers are kept.

props.name: delay

DRAFT: The tooltip surface alone, for triggers that already compose their own Base UI tooltip root (such as a Select).

Portal, positioner and popup for a tooltip whose Root and Trigger are composed elsewhere (e.g. a Select trigger).

props.name: layerClassName
props.description: Stacking layer. Tooltips sit at z-100; previews anchored inside menus use z-90.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes merged onto the shared surface.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Replace the shared surface entirely, for panel-style previews.

components.name: UndoNotice
components.purpose: DRAFT: Undo offer shown in the library top bar's action slot after a move to Trash; never inside the scrolling content.
components.description:
DRAFT: Undo offer shown in the library top bar's action slot after a move to Trash; never inside the scrolling content.

Transient undo offer that lives in the top bar's action slot, so announcing a
move to Trash never pushes the library down. The countdown pauses while the
notice is hovered, focused, busy, or the page is hidden, and the notice never
withdraws itself while the keyboard is inside it.

props.name: message
props.description: Sentence the notice states, for example `Moved “Fix this” to Trash.`

props.name: undoLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the undo button, naming what is restored.

props.name: busy
props.description: A write is in flight; both actions wait.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the notice open, for example after a failed undo that needs a retry.
